purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer/API evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Ukraine's official national cadastral map and NSDI parcel API are evidenced, but no anonymous safe parcel-ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained for Mariupol. Official e-land service text records processing restrictions for active-hostilities or temporarily occupied territories.
registryAssessment: National Ukrainian cadastral custody and public map/API publication are evidenced by first-party documentation. No separate Mariupol municipal registry custodian or citywide parcel feed was established.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official documentation describes the Public Cadastral Map as an information portal publishing State Land Cadastre information and identifies map.land.gov.ua as its access address.
Official NSDI API documentation defines GET /geo/parcel with cadNum or lat/lon parameters and documents a safe response shape including cadastral number and geometry; it also documents rate limits.

Official DGC electronic-services page states that requests concerning DGC objects in active-hostilities or temporarily occupied territories are processed after the relevant access restriction is lifted, except for automatically generated online results.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Legacy Public Cadastral Map route was identified from first-party documentation, but its JavaScript/configuration was not retrieved because the bounded HTTPS request timed out. NSDI parcel route was documented from its official API specification.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Documented example identifies cadnum, category, purpose_code, area, ownershipcode, ppoint, zoom_to, geom, and geom_text; no live response or CRS was verified and source-specific fields were not retained.
viewerConfiguration.nativeFieldNames: Only documented field names were recorded here; no raw feature attribute set was retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: Bounded request timed out after 20 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript configuration, API route, layer schema, or geometry response was retrieved.
HTTP 403 with JSON error Access restricted: request not allowed; no token was supplied or requested and no parcel fields were returned.
A second path check against the documented host returned the same access restriction; no geometry or native identifier was retained.
HTTP 200 first-party service page retrieved; it documents DGC access/processing restrictions for active-hostilities or temporarily occupied territories.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: Exact WUP-point parcel query was attempted against the documented NSDI route without a token and was denied with HTTP 403; legacy public-map retrieval timed out.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Ukrainian national cadastral map and NSDI parcel API documentation; official access restriction notice.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: Exact current viewer configuration, live layer schema, CRS, native parcel identity, anonymous access policy, Mariupol coverage, and citywide completeness remain unverified. Timeout and HTTP 403 are not evidence of cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
